text:
Students arriving from a country with one portal reasonably assume Germany has one too, and it does not. hochschulstart.de handles medicine, dentistry, veterinary medicine and pharmacy. Everything else is applied for through uni-assist or through the university’s own system, one application at a time, with deadlines set by each institution.

Two consequences worth planning around. First, there is no single date to work back from, so the calendar has to be built per university. Second, applicants with a foreign qualification usually need a uni-assist preliminary review before any university will look at them, and that takes weeks — it is best started long before the first institutional deadline rather than in the same week.
attribution: The structure of hochschulstart’s own remit, and uni-assist’s role for foreign qualifications
